command: Implement and verify one bounded zero-cost readiness evidence contract for the V12 observer lineage. Preserve all unrelated and existing uncommitted work. Start from the completed V12 placement-readiness audit and inspect the current observer_diagnostic_control.py, placement_control.py, focused tests, and V12 partial-failure packaging. Use test-driven development. Add deterministic tests first, then the minimum instrumentation needed to emit and retain: (1) public_ip_ready immediately when a public IP is first observed, with event timestamp, elapsed time, and public-IP polling attempt number but no IP address or credential material; (2) ssh_cloud_init_probe_started before the first SSH/cloud-init probe, with event timestamp, elapsed time, attempt number, and the already-computed immutable deadline geometry; and (3) one bounded event per SSH/cloud-init attempt with timestamp, elapsed time, attempt number, return code or typed timeout/error outcome, and success boolean, without command text, IP address, key path, stdout, stderr, or secrets. Prefer a backward-compatible optional callback or typed observer in wait_ssh so existing callers retain identical behavior. Prove with mocked clocks and subprocess results that immediate success, retry-then-success, subprocess timeout/error, deadline timeout, and observer-controller pre-bootstrap failure retain ordered events; prove the events survive the existing partial-evidence/failure archive path. Add fail-closed assertions that the public-IP loop remains capped at started+420 seconds, wait_ssh remains capped at min(absolute deadline, started+480 seconds), the absolute watchdog remains 2000 seconds, the cleanup reserve remains 240 seconds, and no provider command or paid admission is executed in tests. Do not re-anchor or extend a readiness window, prepare or admit a paid identity, query or mutate a provider, change budget authority, change any paid-run deadline, update scientific mechanism beliefs, commit, or push. Preserve STOCK_STARTUP exclusion/isolation, A1/B1/A2 ordering, 8 requests at c8 with 8192 input and 32 output tokens, observer-off/on/off perturbation gates, at least 95% dependency attribution, exact raw request/event/quality/cost/host-GPU telemetry/log retention, hashed manifests, partial-evidence recovery, and verified compute/disk cleanup. Run Python compilation, the focused placement and observer tests, the full campaign unittest suite, factory tests relevant to supervisor/provider contracts, and python3 tools/devex/check.py. Write result.md, evidence-contract.json, deterministic-fixtures.json, changed-files.json, hashes.txt, verification.log, and verification-exit.txt under the supervisor-provided worker output directory. Classify evidence as measured, derived, inferred, or synthetic; report zero paid cost; state whether the contract passes; preserve the unchanged scientific residual bottleneck; and instruct record --kind result after storing the evidence. If any required gate fails, leave the paid-retry prohibition in force and record the failure without retrying unchanged work.
